create_intermediate_hook: create a context manager that registers a callback function to be invoked on intermediate tensor values during PyTorch Inductor compilation
build_run_hooks: build a function call that executes all registered intermediate hooks with a name and value pair
test_intermediate_hook: test the intermediate_hook context manager registers and unregisters callbacks in LIFO order
refactor_run_hooks: refactor run_intermediate_hooks to support async hook execution while preserving registration state
review_intermediate_hooks: review the INTERMEDIATE_HOOKS global list and its thread-safety guarantees during concurrent Inductor compilation
